# 🚨 Disk Space Emergency Response Plan

## 🕵️‍♂️ Current State Analysis
```powershell
# Get disk space overview (run as admin for full details)
Get-Volume | Where-Object {$_.DriveType -eq 'Fixed'} | 
Select-Object DriveLetter, 
    @{Name='Size(GB)';Expression={[math]::Round($_.Size/1GB, 2)}}, 
    @{Name='Free(GB)';Expression={[math]::Round($_.SizeRemaining/1GB, 2)}},
    @{Name='%Free';Expression={[math]::Round(($_.SizeRemaining/$_.Size)*100, 2)}} |
Sort-Object -Property '%Free' -Descending |
Format-Table -AutoSize
```

## 🔍 Deep Dive: Space Hogs
```powershell
# Find large directories (top 10)
$targetDrive = "C:\"
Get-ChildItem -Path $targetDrive -Directory | 
ForEach-Object {
    $size = (Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Recurse -File | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum
    [PSCustomObject]@{
        Directory = $_.FullName
        Size_GB = [math]::Round($size/1GB, 2)
    }
} | Sort-Object -Property Size_GB -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 | Format-Table -AutoSize
```

## 🧹 Safe Cleanup Actions
```powershell
# 1. Clean Windows Temp files (run as admin)
Remove-Item -Path "C:\Windows\Temp\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

# 2. Clean user temp files
Get-ChildItem -Path "C:\Users\*\AppData\Local\Temp" -Recurse | 
    Where-Object { $_.CreationTime -lt (Get-Date).AddDays(-7) } | 
    Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

# 3. Clear Windows Update cache (run as admin)
Stop-Service wuauserv -Force
Remove-Item -Path "C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\*" -Recurse -Force
Start-Service wuauserv
```

## 📊 Monitoring Solution
```powershell
# Create a scheduled task to monitor disk space
$action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'powershell.exe' -Argument '-NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "
    $disks = Get-Volume | Where-Object { $_.DriveType -eq ''Fixed'' -and $_.DriveLetter }
    $report = $disks | ForEach-Object {
        $pctFree = ($_.SizeRemaining / $_.Size) * 100
        if ($pctFree -lt 20) {
            Write-Warning "Low disk space on $($_.DriveLetter): $([math]::Round($pctFree,1))% free"
        }
    }
    # Send email if any disks are below threshold
    if ($report) {
        Send-MailMessage -From "monitor@example.com" -To "admin@example.com" -Subject "Disk Space Alert" -Body ($report -join "`n")
    }
"'
$trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -Daily -At 8am
Register-ScheduledTask -Action $action -Trigger $trigger -TaskName "Disk Space Monitor" -Description "Monitors disk space and sends alerts"
```
